next.reason: 1985: "When the EXTEND phrase is specified and the LABEL RECORDS clause indicates label records are present, ... file labels are processed"; 2023: "GR-14.9.27.4-15 only positions the file 'immediately after the last logical record'; no candidate mentions label records or labels". The 2023 EXTEND rules cover positioning and the volume pointer but say nothing of label processing. The LABEL RECORDS feature and its label steps are not carried.
